stories.why: Linux servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) could be vulnerable to remote code execution through a flaw in the kernel’s networking stack.

stories.title: Why do we keep testing employees for yesterday’s phishing attacks
stories.why: “Yesterday’s price is not today’s price,” a phrase Fat Joe popularized in 2021 , reminds us that what worked yesterday may not deliver the same value today.

stories.title: 26,400 Valid Cloud and AI Credentials Found Exposed in Public Gitee Repositories
stories.why: 26,400 credentials that developers left in public code on Gitee, a Chinese code-hosting service, still worked when a researcher tested them. Anyone who copied one from that code could have used it.

stories.title: Chainalysis breached using “offensive agentic techniques”
stories.why: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis has suffered a cybersecurity incident that led to a data breach. According to the company’s Friday announcement, the incident is unrelated to the recent Binance hack.

stories.title: Ransomware gang talked AI agents into doing much of its dirty work
stories.why: The group behind the Aur0ra ransomware has been using AI agents to move through victim networks, collect credentials and work its way up to domain administrator access, according to Sophos.
